digest.component_or_area: adapters/jira_family value maps and boundary guards
propositions: Two identical copies of the _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE dict literal exist under adapters/ (one in jira/outbound_fields.py and one in jira_datacenter/backend.py), creating risk of silent divergence between Cloud and DC create paths
The existing boundary guards protect STATUS and PRIORITY maps against duplication but do not cover the TYPE map, leaving the defect class unguarded

The two _LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE copies must be consolidated into a single canonical definition in adapters/jira_family/value_maps.py and imported under the historical private alias to preserve module-level attribute resolution

Both create paths (Cloud and DC) must be updated to import the single canonical type map while maintaining the module-level binding that external consumers depend on (test_outbound_differ_session_log_exclusion.py reads _of._LOCAL_TO_JIRA_TYPE as a module attribute)
The boundary guard must be extended to detect and fail on any future introduction of a second TYPE map literal, using the same AST-based detection pattern as the STATUS and PRIORITY guards
